blocks.text: Shyness is mentioned in the Qur'aan as a verb attributed to Allaah. Allaah said,
Verily, Allah is not ashamed to set forth a parable even of a mosquito or so much more when it is bigger (or less when it is smaller) than it.
The Name Al-Hayyiy The One possessing honourable shame is mentioned in two hadeeth:

"The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a man washing in a public place without a lower garment. So he mounted the pulpit, praised and extolled Allah and said: Allah is The One possessing honourable shame (Hayyiy) and The Concealer (Sitteer), He loves modesty and concealment. So when any of you washes, he should conceal himself."
2. Salmaan al-Faarisee said, that the Prophet ﷺ said,
"Indeed your Lord is The One possessing honourable shame (Hayyiy), The Generous (Kareem), He is shy when His servant raises his hands towards Him to return them empty."

This Noble Name affirms shyness and honourable shame is an Attribute of Allaah that is befitting to His Majesty and Perfection. Allaah in all of His Attributes is not like any of His creation and none from His creation comes near to being like Allaah as Allaah said,
There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.
Do you know of any who is similar to Him? (of course none is similar or coequal or comparable to Him, and He has none as partner with Him).
Allaah's honourable shame is a description suited to Him and is not like the shyness of creation.

Speaking about this Attribute is the same as all of the Lord's Attributes. We affirm knowledge for Allaah which is not like our knowledge, He has sight which is not like our sight, He has hearing which is not like our hearing and His Will is not like our will. So the same with His honourable shame which is not like our shame or shyness. Therefore everything that Allaah affirms for Himself or His Messenger ﷺ affirms for Him, is true without any doubt. Allaah is Al-Hayyiy The One possessing honourable shame, He loves modesty and those who are modest. There are many texts that give the order to have modesty and to encourage it and promote it. It is counted as a branch of faith and the texts clarify its great benefits and blessed effects and that it is all goodness.
The greatest modesty and what is most obligatory upon us is to have shyness of Allaah. 'Abdullaah bin Mas'ood said, The Prophet ﷺ said,

"Have modesty and shyness for Allaah as is His due." [He said:] We said: "O Prophet of Allaah! We have shyness, and all praise is due to Allah." He said: "Not that, but having modesty and shyness for Allah which He is due is to protect the head and what it contains and to protect the insides and what it includes, and to remember death and trials, and whoever intends the Hereafter, he leaves the adornments of the world. So whoever does that, then he has indeed fulfilled modesty and shyness, meaning that which Allaah is due."
Allaah grant us shyness of Him. Allaah grant us success to actualise fear of Him when we are alone and in public, secretly and openly.

keyPoints: Shyness is mentioned in the Qur'aan as a verb attributed to Allaah: "Verily, Allah is not ashamed to set forth a parable even of a mosquito..." (Baqarah 2:26).
The Name Al-Hayyiy is mentioned in two hadeeth: that of Ya'alaa bin Umayyah and that of Salmaan al-Faarisee.
The Name affirms shyness and honourable shame as an Attribute of Allaah befitting His Majesty and Perfection, not like the shyness of creation.
Allaah is shy when His servant raises his hands towards Him to return them empty.
Allaah loves modesty and those who are modest; the greatest and most obligatory modesty is to have shyness of Allaah as is His due.

evidence.text: "Allah is The One possessing honourable shame (Hayyiy) and The Concealer (Sitteer), He loves modesty and concealment."
"Indeed your Lord is The One possessing honourable shame (Hayyiy), The Generous (Kareem), He is shy when His servant raises his hands towards Him to return them empty."

recall.a: The One possessing honourable shame; the Name affirms shyness and honourable shame as an Attribute of Allaah befitting His Majesty and Perfection.

recall.q: In which two hadeeth is Al-Hayyiy mentioned?
recall.a: The hadeeth of Ya'alaa bin Umayyah about the man washing in public, and the hadeeth of Salmaan al-Faarisee: "Indeed your Lord is Hayyiy, Kareem, He is shy when His servant raises his hands towards Him to return them empty."

recall.q: Is Allaah's honourable shame like the shyness of creation?
recall.a: No. It is a description suited to Him, just as His knowledge, sight, hearing and Will are not like ours ("There is nothing like unto Him" Shooraa 42:11).

recall.q: According to the hadeeth of Ibn Mas'ood, what is having shyness for Allaah as is His due?
recall.a: To protect the head and what it contains, protect the insides and what they include, remember death and trials, and whoever intends the Hereafter leaves the adornments of the world.
